evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We contribute a turn-labeled multi-turn benchmark (423 conversations, 1,661 labeled turn-states) and an evaluation harness with a simulated user who answers clarifying questions, and use them with six datasets and six open-weight LLMs to test how far probes for unanswerability carry.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models routinely answer questions that cannot be answered from the information given, and in dialogue they answer before enough has been said.
